source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: Materials of exposed machinery and foundations shall be approved by the Administration, or a recognized organization accepted by it, taking into account standards acceptable to the Organization or other standards offering an equivalent level of safety based on the PST.

approvingAuthority: recognized organization accepted by the Administration
